narrative.overview:
The page is one evening walk. It opens in espresso night lit by a single lantern-amber wordmark with her cutout portrait standing in front of it, passes through alternating night and cream daylight bands, and closes on a sunlit stone band where the contact details sit in open daylight. Every color is pulled from her own photographs, so the palette reads as golden hour rather than as a brand kit, and the photography carries the personality while the layout stays editorial and quiet around it.

Density is magazine-like: oversized Gloock display type set against generous section padding, content held to a 1440px measure, and lists drawn as hairline-ruled ledgers instead of card grids. Surfaces are flat. Depth comes from the band sequence and from photographs, not from shadows or containers. Motion is a single slow, decelerating curve used for a staged load moment and gentle reveals, and all of it is gated behind reduced-motion preferences.

Confirmed rejection (from the direction contract): the category default of a split hero with copy beside a rounded photo over rows of equal cards.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating espresso night and cream daylight bands; Ember appears only as the Languages bento card and the SRS project tile.
Gloock high-contrast serif at weight 400 for every display role; Manrope for all reading text; JetBrains Mono for dates.
1px hairline rules as the main structural device, in a night and a day variant.
Square-cornered photographs; controls carry only a 2px corner.
Drawn 1.5px-stroke SVG arrows, square line caps.
One easing curve, cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), across the system.

rules.name: The Night-and-Day Rule
rules.body: Bands alternate espresso night and cream daylight; There is no mid-value band; Ember appears only as a card fill (Languages bento, SRS project tile). Never introduce a grey or cool band.

rules.name: The Ink Swap Rule
rules.body: On a day band, every accent duty that amber or gold performs at night (emphasis, focus, selection, icons) passes to Rust Ink. Amber and gold never appear as text on cream.

rules.name: The Single Lantern Rule
rules.body: Lantern Amber is the only solid accent fill at night: one primary action per cluster, the wordmark, and hover states. Gold is its hover and emphasis step, not a second accent.

rules.name: The One-Weight Serif Rule
rules.body: Gloock is set at weight 400 everywhere; hierarchy comes from size and color, never from bolding the serif. Headings use `text-wrap: balance`.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Date Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on dates. It is not a code or tech-flavor accent.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: No shadows anywhere. Groups are separated by 1px hairlines, band changes, and flat 1px-hairline cards (skills bento at 2px corners, project coverflow cards at 22px).

rules.name: The Square Photograph Rule
rules.body: Photographs never get a radius, frame or drop shadow (except the portrait lift); a 1px hairline border is allowed on project shots.

rules.name: The One-Screen Rule
rules.body: On desktop (1280x720 and larger) every band fits within one screen height. Section padding is the --sec-y token, clamp(40px, 7svh, 84px), and the sizes that set a band's height (headlines, wordmark, about photo, featured project image) scale with screen height as well as width. Body paragraphs cap at 62ch. Phones scroll normally.

dos: **Do** alternate espresso night and cream daylight bands, closing on Sunlit Stone.
**Do** swap every accent to Rust Ink (#8f3e1f) on day bands: emphasis, focus, selection, icons and dates.
**Do** set every Gloock role at weight 400 and build hierarchy from size.
**Do** draw structure with 1px hairlines (night-hairline at night, day-hairline by day) and present lists as ruled ledger rows.
**Do** keep photographs square-cornered at their fixed aspect ratios, and give controls the 2px corner.
**Do** use the single curve cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) for movement and gate every animation behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
**Do** keep icons as drawn 1.5px square-cap SVG strokes in `currentColor`.
donts: **Don't** put Lantern Amber or Hair Gold text on cream or sunlit stone; use Rust Ink.
**Don't** use #b5532c (the lighter brand rust) for text on cream; it measures about 4:1 and fails AA for body copy.
**Don't** wrap projects or skills in shadowed or rounded cards; the only shadow is the hero portrait lift.
**Don't** use JetBrains Mono for anything but dates.
**Don't** introduce grey, cool or saturated non-palette bands; Signal Green is reserved for availability status.
**Don't** use uppercase tracked labels as eyebrows above headings; they belong only to terms inside meta rows, contact rows and the type tile.
